```python
def solve(case):
    nodes = case["nodes"]
    required_symbols = set(case["required_symbols"])
    
    # Build lookup structures
    node_by_id = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes}
    children = {n["id"]: [] for n in nodes}
    for n in nodes:
        if n["parent"] is not None:
            children[n["parent"]].append(n["id"])
    
    # Track retained status
    retained = {n["id"]: True for n in nodes}
    
    # Sort by depth descending, then by node ID ascending as tie-break
    candidates = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    
    removal_order = []
    
    for node in candidates:
        nid = node["id"]
        
        # Skip if not removable
        if not node["removable"]:
            continue
        
        # Skip if symbol is required
        if node["symbol"] in required_symbols:
            continue
        
        # Skip if has any retained children
        if any(retained[c] for c in children[nid]):
            continue
        
        # Tentatively remove: check if all required symbols still covered
        retained[nid] = False
        
        # Check coverage
        symbol_coverage = set()
        for n in nodes:
            if retained[n["id"]]:
                symbol_coverage.add(n["symbol"])
        
        if required_symbols.issubset(symbol_coverage):
            # Keep removed
            removal_order.append(nid)
        else:
            # Restore
            retained[nid] = True
    
    retained_ids = sorted(nid for nid, r in retained.items() if r)
    
    return {
        "removed_node_ids": removal_order,
        "retained_node_ids": retained_ids
    }
```
